newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Post says increases 1996 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Post says increases 1996 earnings.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Post AG postal service operating company said on Friday that earnings from ordinary activities rose 54 percent to 560 million marks in 1996.
The organisation, a privatisation candidate, said at the CeBIT computer fair that 1996 sales rose just 0.1 percent to 28.6 billion marks.
It put the increase in profits down to rationalisation measures that have recently included a reduction of some 22,000 jobs, some seven percent of its workforce.
"The positive trend of previous business years has been continued and we have posted a positive result for the third time in a row," Deutsche Post chief Klaus Zumwinkel said.
